skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and characteristics of digital marketing, including its role and strategic importance in business.
Analyze data and use data-driven decision making in digital marketing.
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies and campaigns.
Manage customer relationships and enhance customer experience in digital environments.
Apply the marketing mix principles in digital marketing contexts.
Communicate effectively in digital marketing contexts.
Work effectively in teams to develop and implement digital marketing strategies.
Identify and solve problems in digital marketing contexts.
Present digital marketing strategies and campaigns effectively.
Think critically about digital marketing strategies and campaigns.
